purpose: Decision-grade issuer-reported borrowing/identified financing population input for non-financial leverage analysis, subject to ratio, uncertainty and risk qualification; not exhaustive financing assurance.
include: Current portion of long borrowings counted once
Separately identified bonds/debt securities not already included
Separately identified finance-lease and sector-applicable lease financing under explicit approved normalization policy
Separately identified other interest-bearing financing not already included
exclude: Unclassified miscellaneous liabilities not explicitly identified as financing
admissionConditions: Qualified issuer stock quantities with exact scope/period/unit
Reported borrowing captions reconcile to relevant notes
Current portion counted once under period-specific presentation
Survey of reported liabilities and financing notes
Every explicitly identified qualifying financing item verified and counted once, with omission/overlap guards
Lease applicability/measurement consistent with sector and period policy
Unclassified liabilities retained visibly without interpreting them as zero
Retained evidence/provenance and later approved contract version
doesNotRequire: Proof that each unspecified miscellaneous payable contains zero financing; this condition belongs to exhaustive population certification.
measurementNote: Use issuer-reported carrying amounts when that is what the qualified statement reports. Verified face/principal amounts require separate proof and cannot be silently equated with carrying amounts.

uncertainty.unclassifiedLiabilityAmount: Known sum of individually listed opaque components; null if an amount is unquantified; not a bound on unreported debt.
uncertainty.unclassifiedLiabilityRatioToBorrowings: Exact numerator/denominator for classified-known opaque amounts only; null for unquantified component or zero borrowing denominator.
uncertainty.materialityAssessment: UNASSESSED_NO_APPROVED_THRESHOLD until case-specific qualified risk review; no universal cutoff inferred.
uncertainty.m3Readiness: Metric quantity availability does not resolve material uncertainty, cash eligibility, lease comparability or scoring governance.
